source.note: single-card witness of the recur stem — a return/recursion zone-change — that ALSO corroborates the sought hole non-play-zone-move (port-topology holes, priority 6). Archaeomancer's ETB spell-recursion moves an instant/sorcery card graveyard->hand: from=graveyard is NOT play and to=hand is NOT play, so it fits NEITHER Removal (from=play) nor Deployment (to=play) — exactly the hidden-zone<->hidden-zone primitive the hole predicts (slang 'reclamation (gy->hand)'). The live engine serves this port as emit:returntohand:spell:instant+sorcery (family=recur, stem=recur, isSelf=false). AST-faithful, not a wish: the Archaeomancer hand-parse (Fixtures/HandParsedCards/M14/Archaeomancer.json) has EffectType=returnToHand with Target.Filter.Zone=Graveyard, Controller=You, CardTypes=[instant,sorcery] — so from=graveyard, to=hand, control=you are all AST-derivable (the returnToHand effect definitionally lands in hand; the target filter proves the graveyard source), none over-approximated. recur is NOT in the scaffold's stems_representative, so it surfaces as an unpredicted witnessed stem (the scaffold's proposed_stem for this hole is 'zonechange (neither removal nor deployment)'; the served engine name is 'recur' — a scaffold reconciliation, zonechange<->recur, is warranted). SCAFFOLD SURFACE: the from/to attribute axes are currently licensed_by removal:*/deployment:* only; this witness extends them to the recur stem (accretion adds recur to from/to.stems and 'hand' to to.values_seen) — the axis KEYS are in the closed set, so no new axis is invented, but their licensed_by should gain the recur/zonechange stem. No popularity source available in the testbed corpus (edhrec/price absent) — omitted.

judge.ref: interaction-judge 2026-07-17 batch-3 — recur/from=graveyard+to=hand faithful, non-play-zone-move hole corroborated (CR 400.7/404.1/402.1); PROCEED (603.6e->603.6a)

Archaeomancer.note: the driver — 'When this creature enters' (Trigger.Event=Enters, Filter.IsSelf=true, CardTypes=[creature]); a self-watching ETB subscription (live etb:creature:self). Already-witnessed stem, shown to ground the card-defined flow into the recur emit.

THE WITNESS — 'return target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand' (EffectType=returnToHand, Target.Filter.Zone=Graveyard, Controller=You, CardTypes=[instant,sorcery]). A recur zone-change graveyard->hand: from=graveyard (proven by the target filter) and to=hand (definitional to returnToHand) are BOTH hidden zones — neither endpoint is play — so this is the non-play-zone-move hole, not Removal (needs from=play) nor Deployment (needs to=play). The returned card being an instant/sorcery (spell-recursion, live emit:returntohand:spell:instant+sorcery) rides in this note rather than as an attr: no card-type axis for the recur target exists in the closed set, and the load-bearing witness is the from->to zone primitive.

notes: 'When Archaeomancer enters, return target instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand' — a deterministic card-defined flow from the ETB subscription to the recur emit; structural (self-certifying), no rule dependency. Mirrors the live CardDefinedEdge etb:creature:self -> emit:returntohand:spell.
